task.description:
WF-01 step 1. Write the requirements for the new direction recorded in decisions/0088 and in docs/owner-requests/2026-10-27-request-list-to-development.md (read both completely; the owner's words are in the second file, pass them verbatim into original_request).

What the owner wants, in short: (1) test mode, nothing is delivered to a customer now, the owner goes through the survey himself and in the end sees the built variant; (2) requests are NOT taken automatically: a list of requests, the owner reads and edits a request and presses «В разработку», then agents build the site; (3) that button is guarded by a password or an equivalent check so that tokens are not spent by accident; (4) the public entry stays the HTML site of the approved sample, pixel with modern shades; (5) LATER phase: a customer who received and accepted the development has a personal cabinet with the Pixel Office showing how his task is worked, and he can submit changes there but not at once (a queue, the owner decides), all multi-tenant.

Do this:
1. Read docs/requirements.yaml (REQ-059, 064-067, 071, 074, 077, 078, 085 first), decisions 0065, 0073, 0074, 0083, 0084, 0088, docs/anti-patterns.md, docs/quality-bar.md, docs/workflows/WF-01-requirement.md and the existing development tools (the run commands, the handoff tool, the workflow documents) so that the requirements fit what exists.
2. Write NEW requirements only, from the next free number (REQ-088 and up), split by size, each one piece of work for one run, with depends_on. Phase A (now): the editing of a request on the board (which fields the owner may edit, validation, what the customer-visible data does after an edit), the password check (where the secret lives outside the repository, how it is compared, lockout after wrong tries, nothing in logs), the button «В разработку» and what it does (a development job record; the single-run rule; a confirmation that shows what will be spent; how the job starts the agents on the owner's computer and in which working folder outside the Sai repository; how the request text is passed as DATA and never as instructions; limits on turns, time and size; what happens on failure, cancel and a restart), the new stage(s) of the progress record and how they reach the customer's page, and how the owner opens the built result at the end. Phase B (later, mark it so and make it depend on phase A): acceptance by the customer, the personal cabinet with the office for his own task through a prepared safe data set, change requests that go to a queue, and tenant isolation (quality-bar Q8) with tests.
3. Do NOT edit any existing block except by a micro-amendment strictly needed for consistency (list each one in result.changes with the before-copy). Specifically propose, as separate small edits or notes, the words «pixel with modern shades» for the pending look/shell requirements (REQ-071, REQ-085, REQ-087) only if their criteria can still be checked.
4. Every choice you make that the owner did not state must be listed in result.choices with a recommended default, so that ORCH can record it. The questions that really need the owner go in result.owner_questions (keep them few, plain, with a default).
5. Security of the start button is the heart of this work: the board stays a local server on the loopback address, the customer's routes still start and change nothing (decisions/0073 as narrowed by 0088), prompt injection through the request text must be named and have a criterion, and spending must be bounded. Give criteria that a test or a command can check (quality-bar Q7-Q11).
6. Write only to docs/requirements.yaml and your handoff. Take the hash of the rest of the file before and after (WF-01 step 1, item 7). No machine paths and no names of other projects in any text.
Nobody else works with docs/requirements.yaml now.

The board handlers in tools/src/picker/board-*.js get their functions as arguments from cli.js and import nothing from devjob or team. choices.default: The existing Sai Team core, executor claude-cli: create a project (ceiling), add ONE task of the role Developer, run it with runTask and a cancel signal. No engine, no planner, no second reviewer run (owner is the reviewer in test mode; a reviewer run would double the spend).
choices.alternative: Engine run with planner and reviewer.

choices.default: One self-contained UTF-8 file index.html, at most 2 MiB (stricter than the core's 5 MiB), starting with a doctype, no external addresses asked for in the brief. A multi-file site is impossible without changing the core (result files are flat and the source is deleted).

choices.about: How the owner opens the result
choices.default: A board route GET /b/<code>/result/<tenant>/<job id>/ for jobs in state built; sha256 re-checked on every read; CSP with `sandbox allow-scripts` (opaque origin, no network, no storage, no access to the board); the page shows the count of external addresses in the file. Opens in a new tab from the button «Открыть результат».
choices.alternative: Download the file; or open it from the folder with the OS.

choices.default: Owner sets it with `picker board-password set` (read from the terminal without echo or from stdin; never from arguments or environment), 8-128 characters, NFC; scrypt hash + salt in <data home>/gate/secret.json (0600) which must lie outside the Sai tree; constant-time compare; 5 wrong tries in a row = 15 minutes lock, persisted in gate/attempts.json (restart does not clear it, a locked gate does not even compute the hash); a broken file closes the gate; the password is typed in the confirmation section for EVERY start; cancel and edit need no password.
choices.alternative: Environment variable; or one unlock for a period of time.

choices.default: Two steps: preview returns a one-time token (128 bit, memory only, 5 minutes, bound to tenant, request, edit version, brief hash and limits) plus the exact brief and the limits; start needs the token and the password. An in-page section, not the browser confirm(). A wrong password does not spend the token.

The answers (full set, recomputed recommended solutions and estimate) and a note «Записка для исполнителей» (0-2000 characters). Not editable: name, contact, via, consent, number. The edit is a separate versioned record; the request file, `leads list`, the stage and the visitor page do not change; «Вернуть как у посетителя» removes it.

The visitor's name and contact are never passed to the agent. The brief is a constant template + one data block between two random-boundary lines (new 32 hex per job), the data as a single JSON line, every string cleaned with the REQ-068 rule and capped, text goes by stdin only; the agent has no Bash and no network; the result is viewed by a human in a sandbox. Residual risk is named in the block and in the README section: the model may still follow text in the data.

Ceiling per job 5 USD (env SAI_DEV_CEILING_USD, 0.5-20); per attempt a quarter of it (core rule); at most 3 attempts of 20 minutes (core rules); whole job deadline 65 minutes (SAI_DEV_DEADLINE_MS, for tests); 3 jobs per request ever; 5 jobs per 24 hours on the whole data folder; one job at a time on the whole board; note 2000 characters; task text 16 KiB; result 2 MiB; token 5 minutes.

Not introduced: the core does not pass a turns flag, and the check of the installed Claude Code was not made here. Replaced by the cost ceiling and the timeouts; the confirmation does not claim a turn limit. If the installed Claude Code has such a flag, a separate requirement to the core is needed.

Closed lists of states and reasons; cancel by signal stops the process group (3 s to SIGKILL) and no late result is accepted; after a board restart a job that was running becomes `interrupted` and NOTHING starts by itself (a new job needs the button again with every check and counts in the limits); kill -9 of the board leaves the agent running to its end within the ceiling (residual risk of the core, written in the README section).
Nothing is sent to the customer: no e-mail, message, notification; no outgoing network from devjob or board handlers (checked by a search and by a connection spy).

Built only after phase A is accepted and the owner says start. Acceptance marks «Передано» and «Принято» are set by the OWNER on the board (no public write path before the cabinet); cabinet by the same personal link as «Мой запрос» (no new login); cabinet data = lang, name, look, number, accepted_at, work, updated_at, changes; the work part comes from a prepared safe set written by the launch at real job transitions (four steps received/working/result/ready or paused, no reasons, no text) so the customer part never reads the Sai Team journal; the change queue: one text up to 1000 characters, 3 open per request, 30 per day per tenant, same text within 10 minutes refused, owner accepts (text appended to the note) or declines, a new job still needs the button, the password and the confirmation; isolation checked on all 4 x 2 x 5 = 40 pairs.

Exactly one real Claude Code run at acceptance, ceiling 2 USD, only after the owner's written consent; tests use a fake executable only. Without consent the criterion is not claimed and the requirement stays in_progress with an honest note (as REQ-001).

No edit of REQ-071, REQ-085, REQ-087. Their criteria already check the look against the approved sample (docs/design/samples/picker-v3-approved-2026-10-26/, decision 0083) and decision 0088 item 5 restates it; «modern shades» is not measurable by a command, so a new criterion for it would not be checkable. Proposal as a note only (see proposals).

owner_questions.default: Да, оставить (число можно менять в одном месте).

owner_questions.ru: Пока агенты строят сайт, показывать ли на странице «Мой запрос» пятый шаг вроде «Строим сайт»?
owner_questions.default: Нет: в тестовом режиме страница посетителя не меняется; ход работы видно на доске у тебя, а заказчик увидит его позже, в личном кабинете (фаза B).
owner_questions.affects: REQ-088 rule 4, REQ-095 crit 2; «yes» means a new WF-01 run for REQ-064...066 and the scene

owner_questions.ru: Разрешаешь один настоящий запуск Claude Code при приёмке (потолок 2 доллара из лимита подписки)? Решение нужно только к концу фазы A.
owner_questions.default: Спросить заново при приёмке; до тех пор все проверки идут на поддельном исполнителе без расхода.

owner_questions.ru: Фаза B: «заказчик принял разработку» отмечаешь ты на доске, или заказчик должен нажимать сам?
owner_questions.default: Отмечаешь ты на доске: у заказчика нет пути записи, пока нет кабинета.
